body:
_Migrated from issue #1057, filed 2026-07-21._

Split out of #866, suggested by @auspex.

Today a new account defaults to syncing the whole library to a Kobo. Marking a shelf for Kobo sync then appears to do nothing until you also switch the account to "sync only my selected shelves" — which is the confusion #866 was actually about. v4.1.19 added the warning and a one-click switch on both shelf types, but the default itself is unchanged.

The argument for flipping it, in the reporter's words: if the default were "selected shelves only", the worst case is that nothing syncs and you go looking for why. The current worst case is a device that grinds through the entire library and goes to sleep before finishing.

Worth weighing before changing anything:

- It changes behaviour for existing installs unless it applies to new users only, which is the safer shape.
- Stock Calibre-Web's behaviour here should be checked rather than assumed — the reporter recalls not hitting this there.
- A first-sync-is-empty experience needs to be self-explanatory, or it trades one confusion for another.

No commitment to a particular outcome yet; filing so the suggestion is tracked rather than buried in a closed-out thread.
title: Consider defaulting new users to "sync only selected shelves" for Kobo
